title: Digital Realty Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: AUSTIN, Texas, June 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Digital Realty ( NYSE: DLR), the world’s largest cloud- and carrier-neutral data center platform, today announced that it will release financial results for the second quarter of 2026 after the market closes on Thursday, July 23, 2026.
